name: Sour Player
subtitle: The music player for Hermes Music

apps.name: Sour Player
apps.subtitle: The music player for Hermes Music
apps.localizedDescription: Play your Navidrome / Hermes Music library on your iPhone: lock screen and Control Center controls, AirPods buttons, background playback, offline playlists, the Sour Stage, profiles, listen along and Group Play.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sour Player connects to your music server and Hermes Music on your home network.

versions.localizedDescription: Volume slider in the player, Sour Player TV inside the app (Home > TV party), and with Hermes Music 3.13: new look, word-by-word lyrics, new video player.

Connects away from home: iOS was blocking plain-http Tailscale addresses (the 100.x address and the Tailscale name) because of a setting in the app. Can't reach Hermes Music? It says so, keeps trying and opens by itself. You > Phone settings > Hermes Music address switches addresses. The music server address is filled in at sign-in.

The phone app look (tabs, mini player, sheets, tap to play), the Sour Stage with the video behind the lyrics and Rainy day / Stormy night, Not the right song, and everything else from the computer version.

No more network errors (the app runs from your Hermes Music; type its address the first time). A real iPhone look: tab bar, floating mini player, sheets, large titles. No zooming on text boxes, no keyboard shortcuts.
Music keeps playing in the background and changes songs with the screen locked; lock screen, Control Center and AirPods buttons work.

apps.name: Sour Player TV
apps.subtitle: Run the party on the TV (admins)
apps.localizedDescription: For Hermes Music admins: your iPhone runs an event's Group Play and plays the music; with Screen Mirroring the TV shows the party big (cover, lyrics, up next, chat and reactions) without the buttons. People you add can queue songs from their own Sour Player.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sour Player TV connects to Hermes Music on your home network.

versions.localizedDescription: The TV picture keeps changing songs (it froze on the first one). Needs Hermes Music 3.8.5.
Fixes "Can't reach Hermes Music" when its address is an IP (like 100.69.236.80:3340).
The TV picture shows the song, cover and lyrics. Needs Hermes Music 3.8.4.
First version: the party on your phone, a clean picture of it on the mirrored TV. Needs Hermes Music 3.8.3.
